description: This file implements a Clang-based AST visitor and consumer for extracting and processing C++ header information, including declarations of records, enums, functions, and variables, for ABI analysis and serialization.

classes.name: PrintNormalizedPath
classes.description: A callback class for normalizing file paths based on root directories.

classes.name: HeaderASTVisitor
classes.description: AST visitor class that processes declarations for header analysis, including records, enums, functions, and variables.

classes.name: HeaderASTConsumer
classes.description: Clang AST consumer that sets up the AST visitor and handles the translation unit for ABI extraction.

methods.name: VisitRecordDecl
methods.description: Processes record (struct/union/class) declarations, skipping invalid, forward, anonymous, or non-visible declarations.

methods.name: VisitEnumDecl
methods.description: Processes enum declarations, skipping non-definitions or dependent types.

methods.name: ShouldSkipFunctionDecl
methods.description: Determines if a function declaration should be skipped based on linkage, definition, template, or other attributes.

methods.name: VisitFunctionDecl
methods.description: Processes function declarations, handling mangling and linkage naming.

methods.name: VisitVarDecl
methods.description: Processes global or static variable declarations.

methods.name: TraverseDecl
methods.description: Recursively traverses declarations, filtering based on source file and export options.

methods.name: HandleTranslationUnit
methods.description: Sets up the AST context, runs the AST visitor, and serializes the extracted ABI information.
